gates.finding: Exact sources are approved for planning, but current access-time terms and intended-use rights have not been verified.
gates.remediation: After M2 activation, record the current provider terms and rights assessment without accepting changed terms automatically.

gates.finding: No full-product archive, transfer receipt, local SHA-256, or immutable custody chain exists.
gates.remediation: Acquire only the exact approved products under M2 authority and retain transfer, checksum, failure, and promotion evidence.

gates.finding: Archive integrity, SAFE structure, required bands or polarizations, and raster readability have not been tested on product bytes.
gates.remediation: Run the offline container verifier, then inspect every required raster and internal metadata identity.

gates.finding: Catalog footprints do not establish usable coverage of each approved AOI or balanced before/after evidence routes.
gates.remediation: Measure AOI intersection, valid-pixel fractions, and before/after optical and radar coverage after opening the rasters.

gates.finding: The schema can retain exclusions and adverse states, but no product-level cloud, terrain, radar, nodata, or uncertainty evidence exists.
gates.remediation: Populate explicit exclusion and QA records without coercing unresolved pixels or products into accepted evidence.

gates.finding: Product dates and roles are fixed, but orbit geometry, comparable grids, stable controls, and before/after pair fitness remain unverified.
gates.remediation: Evaluate optical and radar pairs independently and quantify registration on stable terrain before change analysis.

gates.finding: Static controls are reproducible, but no acquired product or analysis-ready derivative can yet be rebuilt from local custody.
gates.remediation: Bind acquired bytes, environment, processing parameters, intermediate hashes, and rerun evidence after M2 activation.

gates.finding: Required QA families are documented, but scene-specific thresholds, stable-reference results, and acceptance criteria are not complete.
gates.remediation: Fix scene-specific QA thresholds before change classification and preserve failed or inconclusive routes.

gates.finding: The exact M2 acquisition proposal has not received a completed owner decision.
gates.remediation: Obtain and lock an exact M2 activation decision before authentication, custody creation, or download.
